`uptimeSeconds` lets an operator tell a restarting process from a routing problem.
How this server is configured\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Tells a client whether payments are mock or sandbox, whether reviews are simulated, and the upload size limit.
Create projects and read their public state and audit log.
List projects\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Also refreshes any payouts that PayPal has accepted but not yet settled.
Create a project\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Stage percentages must add up to 100. Each stage has a time window in which its evidence\nmust be photographed. The response contains the worker key; keep it, it is shown once.\n
Read one project\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The public view: donations, totals, stages and each stage's submissions. Send\n`X-Worker-Key` to also receive the one-time code of the active stage.\n
Read the audit log and check its hash chain\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every decision is an entry that includes the hash of the one before it, so altering history breaks the chain.
Reserve money on PayPal. Nothing is taken until a stage is verified.
Reserve a donation on PayPal\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Creates a PayPal order with intent AUTHORIZE: the money stays in the donor's account and
is only reserved. On the sandbox, send the donor to `approveUrl` to approve it; they are
then returned to the site and the reservation is confirmed. In mock mode there is no
approval step and the donation is confirmed immediately.
PayPal return link (browser redirect)\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
PayPal sends the donor's browser here after approval with `?token=\x3Corder id>`. It confirms\nthe reservation and redirects back to the site. This is not meant to be called by an API client.\n
Upload and view the photo evidence for each stage.
Upload photo evidence for a stage\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

The body is the raw image (JPEG or PNG), not a form. The server checks for duplicates,
location and time from the photo's metadata, and that the one-time code is visible, then
asks two independent AI reviewers. The deterministic gate decides: RELEASE, RESUBMIT,
HOLD (a human decides) or BLOCK. On RELEASE each donor's share is captured and the worker
is paid.

On a demo server with simulated reviewers, `demoCode`, `demoMatch` and `demoFlags` steer
the simulated reviewers; they are ignored when real reviewers are used.
Fetch an evidence photo\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Public only after the submission has released funds. Before that, the worker or verifier key is required.
The human verifier queue for held cases.
Submissions waiting for a human\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Submissions the gate held for review, and ones whose payment release failed and needs a retry.
Approve or reject a held submission\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Approval is bound to the evidence the verifier saw: send the `evidenceHash` from the queue\nitem. If the evidence changed since, the call fails with 409 and nothing is released.\n
